rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「선거관리위원회법」(이하 “법”이라 한다)에서 위임된 사항과 기타 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다. <개정 2005. 5. 12.>
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the National Election Commission Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and other matters necessary for its implementation. <Amended May 12, 2005>

rows.source_ko: 제2조(구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회의 명칭ㆍ관할구역ㆍ사무소소재지) 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회의 명칭ㆍ관할구역 및 사무소소재지는 별표 1과 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Name, Jurisdiction, and Location of Office of District, City, and County Election Commissions) The names, jurisdictions, and locations of offices of District, City, and County Election Commissions are as set forth in Attached Table 1.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(국회의원지역선거구 관할선거관리위원회) ①국회의원선거에 있어 법 제2조제6항의 규정에 의한 지역선거구의 선거사무를 행하는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회는 다음 각호의 기준에 의하여 지정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Election Management Committee with Jurisdiction over Regional Constituencies for Members of the National Assembly) ① The district, city, or county election management committee responsible for conducting election affairs for regional constituencies pursuant to the provisions of Article 2, Paragraph 6 of the Act in the election of members of the National Assembly shall be designated according to the criteria in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 선거관리위원회가 관할하는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 구역안에 1개의 지방법원 또는 지방법원지원이 있는 경우에는 당해 구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 구역을 관할하는 선거관리위원회. 다만, 각각의 선거관리위원회가 관할하는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군마다 지방법원 또는 지방법원지원이 있는 경우에는 교통의 중심지 또는 인구가 많은 구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 구역을 관할하는 선거관리위원회
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where there is one district court or branch district court within the area of a district, city, or county under the jurisdiction of an Election Commission, the Election Commission having jurisdiction over the said district, city, or county. However, in cases where there is a district court or branch district court in each district, city, or county under the jurisdiction of a separate Election Commission, the Election Commission having jurisdiction over the area of the district, city, or county that is a transportation hub or has a large population.

rows.source_ko: 2. 지역선거구의 구역안에 지방법원 또는 지방법원지원이 없는 경우에는 교통의 중심지 또는 인구가 많은 구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 구역을 관할하는 선거관리위원회
rows.text_en: 2. In cases where there is no district court or branch court within the boundaries of a regional electoral district, the election commission having jurisdiction over the area of a transportation hub or a densely populated district, city, or county.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 기준에 의하여 당해 지역선거구의 선거사무를 관장하는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회는 별표 2와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The district, city, and county election commissions in charge of election affairs for the relevant electoral district in accordance with the standards of Paragraph 1 are as set forth in Attached Table 2.

rows.source_ko: ③ 자치구가 아닌 구의 일부를 분할하거나, 「공직선거법」제25조제1항제2호 단서에 따라 자치구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 일부를 분할하여 획정한 국회의원지역선거구의 선거사무를 행할 선거관리위원회는 별표 2-2와 같다. <개정 2012. 3. 2., 2016. 3. 3.>
rows.text_en: ③ The election commissions authorized to conduct election affairs for National Assembly constituencies demarcated by dividing a part of a district that is not an autonomous district, or by dividing a part of an autonomous district, city, or county pursuant to the proviso of Article 25, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 2 of the Public Official Election Act, are as set forth in Attached Table 2-2. <Amended Mar. 2, 2012; Mar. 3, 2016>
[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 1991]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의2(시장선거구 등 관할선거관리위원회) ①시장선거와 비례대표시의원선거에 있어 법 제2조제6항의 규정에 의한 선거구의 선거사무를 행할 선거구선거관리위원회는 별표 2-3과 같다. <개정 2005. 12. 19., 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Competent Election Commissions for Mayoral Electoral Districts, etc.) ① The electoral district election commissions responsible for conducting election affairs for electoral districts pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 6 of the Act in the election of mayor and the election of city council members for proportional representation are as set forth in Attached Table 2-3. <Amended Dec. 19, 2005; Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③지역선거구시ㆍ도의회의원선거에 있어 법 제2조제6항에 따른 선거구의 선거사무를 행할 선거구선거관리위원회는 별표 2-4와 같다. <신설 2005. 12. 19., 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ The electoral district election management committees to perform election affairs for electoral districts pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 6 of the Act in regional electoral district elections for members of city or provincial councils are as set forth in Attached Table 2-4. <Newly added Dec. 19, 2005; Nov. 30, 2022>
④ Deleted <July 29, 2014>
⑤ Deleted <July 29, 2014>

[Wholly Amended Oct. 26, 1998]
[Title Amended Dec. 19, 2005]

rows.source_ko: 제3조의3(읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회의 설치 등) ①구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 장은 관할구역 안의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동의 명칭을 변경하거나 설치ㆍ폐지ㆍ분할 또는 합병하는 당해 지방자치단체의 조례안이 발의된 때에는 지체 없이 그 뜻을 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원장에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Establishment, etc. of Eup, Myeon, and Dong Election Management Committees) ① When a bill for an ordinance of the relevant local government is proposed to change the name of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong within its jurisdiction, or to establish, abolish, divide, or merge it, the head of a district, city, or county shall notify the chairperson of the district, city, or county election management committee of such intention without delay.

rows.source_ko: ②구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원장은 제1항의 통지를 받은 때에는 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동의 명칭변경이나 설치ㆍ폐지ㆍ분할 또는 합병을 위한 당해 지방자치단체의 조례의 효력이 발생하는 날까지 해당 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회의 명칭을 변경하거나 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회를 설치하는 등 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다. 다만, 부득이한 사유가 있는 때에는 조례의 효력이 발생한 날부터 30일 이내에 조치하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving the notice under Paragraph 1, the Chairperson of the District, City, or County Election Commission shall take necessary measures, such as changing the name of the relevant Eup, Myeon, or Dong Election Commission or establishing an Eup, Myeon, or Dong Election Commission, by the date on which the ordinance of the relevant local government for the change of name or establishment, abolition, division, or merger of an Eup, Myeon, or Dong takes effect. However, if there are unavoidable circumstances, such measures shall be taken within 30 days from the date on which the ordinance takes effect.

rows.source_ko: ③제2항 단서의 규정에 의하여 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회가 설치되는 때까지는 다음 각 호에서 정하는 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회가 그사무를 처리한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Until an Eup, Myeon, or Dong election management committee is established pursuant to the provisions of the proviso to Paragraph 2, the Eup, Myeon, or Dong election management committees specified in each of the following subparagraphs shall handle the affairs.

rows.source_ko:
1. 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동이 분할ㆍ설치되는 경우
분할 전의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회
rows.text_en:
1. In cases where Eup, Myeon, or Dong is divided or established,
the Eup, Myeon, or Dong Election Management Committee prior to the division

rows.source_ko:
2. 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동이 합병ㆍ폐지되는 경우
구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원장이 지정하는 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회
rows.text_en:
2. In cases where Eup, Myeon, or Dong is merged or abolished,
the Eup, Myeon, or Dong Election Management Committee designated by the Chairperson of the Gu, Si, or Gun Election Management Committee
[This Article was newly established on August 4, 2005.]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(위원추천) 법 제4조제2항의 규정에 의하여 지방법원장이 위원을 추천하는 경우에는 별지 제1호서식, 법 제5조제4항의 단서규정에 의하여 지방법원장 또는 지원장이 위원을 추천하는 경우에는 별지 제1-1호서식, 정당에서 위원을 추천하는 경우에는 별지 제1-2호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Recommendation of Members) In cases where the Chief Judge of a district court recommends a member pursuant to the provisions of Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Act, Form No. 1 of the Appendix shall be used; in cases where the Chief Judge of a district court or the Chief Judge of a branch court recommends a member pursuant to the proviso of Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act, Form No. 1-1 of the Appendix shall be used; and in cases where a political party recommends a member, Form No. 1-2 of the Appendix shall be used.
[Wholly Amended May 13, 1995]
Article 4-2 Deleted <Mar. 12, 2004>

rows.source_ko: 제5조(위원의 위촉 및 해촉) ①각급선거관리위원회의 위원으로 위촉되는 자는 별지 제2호서식에 의한 본인승낙 및 비당원확인서와 주민등록표초본을 위촉하는 선거관리위원회에 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 법관, 법원공무원, 정당의 당원이 될 수 없는 교육공무원ㆍ사립학교교원의 경우에는 별지 제2-1호서식에 의한 본인승낙서를 제출하고, 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회의 위원으로 위촉되는 자는 주민등록표초본을 제출하지 아니한다. <개정 1994. 3. 2., 1994. 12. 30., 1995. 5. 13.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Appointment and Dismissal of Members) ① Persons appointed as members of election management committees at all levels shall submit a form of personal consent and confirmation of non-party membership in accordance with Form No. 2 attached hereto, along with an extract of the resident registration record, to the appointing election management committee. However, in the case of judges, court officials, and educational officials and private school teachers who are ineligible to become members of a political party, they shall submit a form of personal consent in accordance with Form No. 2-1 attached hereto; and persons appointed as members of city or provincial election management committees shall not submit an extract of the resident registration record. <Amended Mar. 2, 1994; Dec. 30, 1994; May 13, 1995>

rows.source_ko: ②법 제4조제2항 내지 제4항의 규정에 의하여 위원을 위촉하는 선거관리위원회는 위원으로 위촉하고자 하는 자의 등록기준지 관할 구ㆍ시ㆍ읍ㆍ면의 장에게 선거권 유무 조회를 의뢰하여 국회의원선거권이 있는지를 조사한 후 동 선거권이 있는 자를 위원으로 위촉하여야 한다. 다만, 정당에서 추천된 자는 위촉한 후에 국회의원선거권이 있는지를 조사하여 동 선거권이 없음이 확인된 때에는 지체없이 당해 위원을 해촉하여야 한다. <개정 1994. 3. 2., 1995. 5. 13., 2010. 7. 26., 2018. 3. 9.>
rows.text_en: ② An Election Commission appointing members pursuant to Article 4(2) through (4) of the Act shall request the head of the competent eup, myeon, or dong having jurisdiction over the registered domicile of the person to be appointed as a member to inquire into the existence of voting rights, investigate whether such person has the right to vote in National Assembly elections, and then appoint a person who possesses said voting rights as a member. However, if a person recommended by a political party is investigated for the right to vote in National Assembly elections after appointment and it is confirmed that such right does not exist, the relevant member shall be dismissed without delay. <Amended Mar. 2, 1994; May 13, 1995; Jul. 26, 2010; Mar. 9, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③법관ㆍ법원공무원ㆍ교육공무원 및 사립학교교원을 각급 선거관리위원회의 위원으로 위촉하는 경우에는 제1항 및 제2항의 규정에 불구하고 주민등록표초본의 제출과 선거권 유무 조회에 의한 조사를 하지 아니한다. 다만, 사립학교교원인 경우는 주민등록표초본을 제출하여야 한다. <개정 1994. 3. 2., 1996. 2. 6., 2018. 3. 9.>
rows.text_en: ③ Notwithstanding the provisions of Paragraphs 1 and 2, when appointing judges, court officials, education officials, and private school teachers as members of election management committees at each level, the submission of a certified copy of the resident registration record and an investigation regarding the existence of voting rights shall not be required. However, in the case of private school teachers, a certified copy of the resident registration record must be submitted. <Amended Mar. 2, 1994; Feb. 6, 1996; Mar. 9, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ④제2항에 따른 국회의원선거권 조사 결과 선거권이 없음이 확인된 자나 해촉된 위원이 지방법원장이나 정당에서 추천한 자일 경우에는 당해 추천권자에게 이를 지체없이 통지하여야 한다. <신설 1994. 3. 2., 2018. 3. 9.>
rows.text_en: ④ If a person confirmed to be ineligible to vote as a result of the investigation into voting rights for National Assembly elections under Paragraph 2, or a member who has been dismissed, is a person recommended by the Chief Judge of a District Court or a political party, such recommendation shall be notified without delay. <Newly added Mar. 2, 1994; Mar. 9, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ⑤각급 선거관리위원회가 위원을 해임ㆍ해촉할 때에는 본인의 사직원이나 법 제4조제2항 내지 제4항의 규정에 의한 자격요건이나 거주요건의 흠결 또는 법 제9조에 규정된 해임사유에 해당함을 증명하는 증빙이 있어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When an election commission at any level dismisses or removes a member, there must be proof that the member has submitted a letter of resignation, has a defect in the qualifications or residency requirements under Article 4, Paragraphs 2 through 4 of the Act, or has a ground for dismissal stipulated in Article 9 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: ⑥위원을 위촉한 때에는 별지 제3호서식에 의한 위촉장을 교부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ When a member is appointed, a letter of appointment in accordance with Form No. 3 attached hereto shall be issued.

rows.source_ko: ⑦위원을 해촉하거나 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 상임위원의 지명을 해제한 때에는 별지 제4호서식에 의한 인사발령통지서를 교부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ When a member is dismissed or the designation of a standing member of a city or provincial election commission is revoked, a notice of personnel appointment in accordance with Form No. 4 attached hereto shall be issued.

rows.source_ko: ⑧위원을 위촉한 때에는 다음 각호의 인사관리서류를 비치하고 기록ㆍ관리하여야 한다. <개정 1994. 3. 2.>
rows.text_en: ⑧ When members are appointed, the personnel management documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs shall be kept, recorded, and managed. <Amended Mar. 2, 1994>
1. Register of Appointments for Members (Attachment No. 5)
2. List of Members (Attachment No. 6)
3. Public Official Personnel Record Card (Limited to Standing Members of the National Election Commission and City/Provincial Election Commissions)

rows.source_ko: 제5조의2(보조위원) ①법 제4조제13항의 규정에 의한 보조위원은 당해 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회의 관할구역안에 거주하는 국회의원선거권이 있고 정당원이 아닌 자중에서 법 같은 조 같은 항의 규정에 의한 정당의 당해 당부(당해 당부가 없을 때에는 그 상급 당부)가 추천한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-2 (Auxiliary Members) ①The auxiliary members pursuant to the provisions of Article 4, Paragraph 13 of the Act shall be recommended by the relevant party branch of a political party pursuant to the provisions of the same Article and Paragraph of the Act (or the superior party branch if there is no relevant party branch) from among persons who reside within the jurisdiction of the relevant district, city, or county election commission, have the right to vote for National Assembly elections, and are not members of a political party.

rows.source_ko: ②구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회위원장은 선거일전 12일까지 제1항의 당부에 보조위원의 추천을 의뢰하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The chairperson of the district, city, or county election management committee shall request the recommendation of assistant members from the party referred to in paragraph 1 by 12 days prior to the election day.

rows.source_ko: ③보조위원을 추천하는 때에는 별지 제2-2호서식에 의한 추천서와 별지 제2-3호서식에 의한 본인승낙 및 비당원확인서를 당해 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회에 선거일전 2일까지 제출하여야 하며 보조위원을 교체하고자 할 때에도 이와 같다.
rows.text_en: ③ When recommending an assistant member, a recommendation form in accordance with Form No. 2-2 and a confirmation of consent and non-party membership in accordance with Form No. 2-3 must be submitted to the relevant district, city, or county election commission by two days prior to the election day, and the same applies when intending to replace an assistant member.

rows.source_ko: ④구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회는 제1항의 규정에 의하여 보조위원으로 추천된 자에 대하여 제5조제2항 본문의 규정에 의한 조사를 한 후 국회의원선거권이 있는 자를 당해 선거일 전일까지 위촉하여야 한다. 다만, 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 관할구역안의 구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 장이 작성한 당해 선거의 선거인명부에 등재되어 있는 자에 대하여는 동 조사를 아니하고 위촉할 수 있다. <개정 2012. 3. 2.>
rows.text_en: ④ The District, City, or County Election Commission shall, after conducting an investigation pursuant to the provisions of the main clause of Article 5, Paragraph 2 regarding persons recommended as auxiliary members under the provisions of Paragraph 1, appoint persons eligible to vote in National Assembly elections by the day before the relevant election. However, persons listed in the voter register for the relevant election prepared by the head of the District, City, or County within the jurisdiction of the District, City, or County Election Commission may be appointed without conducting the said investigation. <Amended Mar. 2, 2012>

rows.source_ko: ⑤보조위원의 근무기간은 당해 선거의 선거일 오후 6시부터 개표종료시까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The term of service for assistant members shall be from 6:00 PM on the day of the election until the end of vote counting.

rows.source_ko: ⑥보조위원이 개표사무에 종사하거나 개표사무와 관련된 교육을 받은 때에는 예산의 범위안에서 별표 4중 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원의 일비액에 상당하는 수당을 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ When an assistant member engages in vote counting duties or receives training related to vote counting duties, an allowance equivalent to the daily allowance of a member of a district, city, or county election commission as specified in Table 4 may be paid within the limits of the budget.
[This Article was newly established on Dec. 30, 1994.]

rows.source_ko: 제5조의3(법관의 부위원장위촉) ①법 제5조제4항의 단서규정에 의하여 부위원장을 위촉하고자 하는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회위원장은 선거일전 12일까지 당해 지역을 관할하는 지방법원장 또는 지원장에게 법관 1인의 위원추천을 의뢰하고, 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회는 선거일전 5일까지 위촉한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5-3 (Appointment of a Judge as Vice Chairperson) ① The chairperson of a district, city, or county election commission who intends to appoint a vice chairperson pursuant to the proviso of Article 5, Paragraph 4 of the Act shall request the chief judge of the district court or branch court having jurisdiction over the relevant area to recommend one judge as a member by 12 days prior to the election day, and the district, city, or county election commission shall appoint the vice chairperson by 5 days prior to the election day.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의하여 위촉된 부위원장은 위촉된 날부터 당해 선거의 당선인이 결정되는 날까지 근무한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Vice Chairperson appointed pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall serve from the date of appointment until the date the winner of the relevant election is determined.
[This Article was newly established on May 13, 1995.]

rows.source_ko: 제6조(정당추천위원 결원 통지) 정당추천위원이 결원된 경우 관계 선거관리위원회의 당해 당부에 대한 결원통지는 별지 제8호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Notice of Vacancy of Party-Recommended Member) In the event of a vacancy among party-recommended members, the relevant election commission shall notify the party of the vacancy in accordance with Form No. 8 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(정ㆍ부위원장 선출공고 및 보고) 각급 선거관리위원회는 그 위원회의 정ㆍ부위원장을 선출한 때에는 이를 별지 제9호서식에 의하여 공고하고, 그 상급선거관리위원회에 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Notice and Report on Election of President and Vice-President) When an election management committee at any level has elected its president and vice-president, it shall make a notice in accordance with Form No. 9 attached hereto and report it to its superior election management committee.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(부위원장의 직무) 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회와 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회의 부위원장은 위원장이 사고가 있을 때에 그 직무를 대행한다. <개정 2005. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Duties of Vice Chairpersons) The Vice Chairpersons of the District, City, and County Election Management Committees and the Eup, Myeon, and Dong Election Management Committees shall perform the duties of the Chairperson in the event of the Chairperson's absence. <Amended Aug. 4, 2005>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(중앙선거관리위원회 상임위원의 호선 및 감독권) ①법 제6조제2항의 규정에 의한 상임위원의 호선은 재적위원 과반수의 찬성으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Election and Supervisory Authority of Standing Members of the National Election Commission) ①The election of standing members pursuant to the provisions of Article 6, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall be made by the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의하여 호선된 상임위원의 재임기간은 3년으로 한다. 다만, 중앙선거관리위원회 위원으로서의 잔여임기가 3년 미만인 때에는 그 잔여임기까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The term of office of a standing member elected by mutual consent pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall be three years. However, if the remaining term of office as a member of the National Election Commission is less than three years, the term of office shall be until the remaining term.

rows.source_ko: ③ 상임위원은 사무처로 하여금 중요사항에 대하여 위원회의에 보고하게 할 수 있으며, 법 제6조제1항에 따른 감독권의 구체적인 범위는 중앙선거관리위원회 훈령으로 정한다. <신설 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Standing Commissioners may have the Secretariat report to the Committee on important matters, and the specific scope of the supervisory authority under Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall be determined by a directive of the National Election Commission. <Newly added Nov. 30, 2022>

[This Article was newly inserted on Oct. 20, 1999.]
[Title amended on Nov. 30, 2022.]
[Former Article 9 moved to Article 9-2 <Oct. 20, 1999>]

rows.source_ko: 제9조의2(시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 상임위원의 지명) ①법 제6조제3항제3호에 규정된 자를 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회의 상임위원으로 지명할 때에는 4급 이상 공무원으로 7년 이상 선거 및 정당사무에 종사한 경력이 있는 자중에서 지명한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9-2 (Designation of Standing Members of City/Provincial Election Commissions) ① When designating a person specified in Article 6, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 3 of the Act as a standing member of a City/Provincial Election Commission, the designation shall be made from among those who have served as a public official of Grade 4 or higher and have worked in election and party affairs for at least 7 years.

rows.source_ko: ②시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 상임위원의 지명기간은 2년으로 한다. 다만, 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 위원으로서의 잔여임기가 2년 미만인 때에는 지명기간은 잔여임기까지로 한다. <개정 1998. 10. 26., 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ② The term of appointment for a standing member of a City or Provincial Election Commission shall be two years. However, if the remaining term of office as a member of a City or Provincial Election Commission is less than two years, the term of appointment shall extend to the remainder of the term. <Amended Oct. 26, 1998; Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 상임위원이 재임중 다른 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 위원으로 위촉되어 새로이 상임위원으로 지명된 때에도 전임 재임기간을 합산하며, 합산한 기간이 2년에 달할 때에 당연히 그 지명이 해제된 것으로 본다. <개정 1998. 10. 26., 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Even if a standing member of a City or Provincial Election Commission is appointed as a member of another City or Provincial Election Commission and newly designated as a standing member while in office, the previous term of office shall be added to the current term; and when the combined period reaches two years, the designation shall be deemed automatically revoked. <Amended Oct. 26, 1998; Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ④중앙선거관리위원회는 지명기간이 만료된 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 상임위원에 대하여는 상당한 이유가 있다고 인정되는 때에는 제2항의 규정에 불구하고 2년 이내의 기간을 정하여 새로이 지명할 수 있다. <개정 2002. 6. 18., 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ Notwithstanding the provisions of Paragraph 2, the National Election Commission may appoint a standing member of a City or Provincial Election Commission whose term of appointment has expired for a period not exceeding two years if it is deemed that there are substantial grounds. <Amended June 18, 2002; November 30, 2022>
⑤ Deleted <October 20, 1999>

rows.source_ko: ⑥시ㆍ도선거관리위원회의 상임위원을 지명한 때에는 별지 제9-2호서식에 의한 임명장을 교부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ When a standing member of the City/Provincial Election Commission is designated, a letter of appointment in accordance with Form No. 9-2 shall be issued.

[Wholly Amended Dec. 31, 1987]
[Title Amended Oct. 20, 1999]
[Moved from Article 9 Oct. 20, 1999>]
Article 10 Deleted <March 2, 1994>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(위원회의) ①각급 선거관리위원회의 회의의안은 의결사항과 보고사항으로 구분하며 별지 제11호서식에 의하여 작성하고 회의개최 2일전까지 각 위원에게 배부한다. 다만, 긴급한 의안은 그러하지 아니하다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Committee) ① The agenda of each election management committee shall be classified into matters for resolution and matters for reporting, prepared in accordance with Form No. 11 attached hereto, and distributed to each member at least two days prior to the meeting. However, this shall not apply to urgent agenda items.

rows.source_ko: ②의안은 연도별 일련번호를 붙이며, 별지 제12호서식의 의안대장에 등재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Bills shall be assigned annual serial numbers and registered in the Bill Register in the form of Annex 12.

rows.source_ko: ③ 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 사항은 중앙선거관리위원회의 의결을 거쳐야 한다. <신설 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ③ Matters falling under any of the following subparagraphs shall be subject to a resolution by the National Election Commission. <Newly added Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 중앙선거관리위원회 규칙의 제정 및 개정에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 1. Matters concerning the enactment and amendment of the rules of the National Election Commission

rows.source_ko: 2. 법 제17조제1항에 따른 관계 법령안에 대한 의견표시(중요사항에 한정한다) 및 같은 조 제2항에 따른 관계 법률의 제정ㆍ개정 의견제출에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the expression of opinions on draft relevant laws pursuant to Article 17, Paragraph 1 of the Act (limited to important matters) and the submission of opinions on the enactment or amendment of relevant laws pursuant to Paragraph 2 of the same Article

rows.source_ko: 3. 법규 해석에 관한 사항으로서 기존 결정ㆍ선례 변경이나 새로운 선례 형성이 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the interpretation of regulations that require the modification of existing decisions or precedents, or the establishment of new precedents.

rows.source_ko: 4. 예산요구 및 결산에 관한 사항으로서 다음 각 목 어느 하나에 해당하는 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning budget requests and settlement of accounts falling under any of the following items
a. Budget request pursuant to Article 31 of the National Finance Act
B. Central government settlement report pursuant to Article 58 of the National Finance Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 법령에 따라 중앙선거관리위원회 위원회의에서 정하도록 하는 사항
rows.text_en: 5. Matters to be determined by the Committee of the National Election Commission in accordance with laws and regulations

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 중요한 사항으로서 중앙선거관리위원회 위원장이 위원회의에 부치는 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other important matters submitted to the Committee by the Chairperson of the National Election Commission

rows.source_ko: ④위원회의를 소집하기 어려운 긴급한 사정이 있거나, 경미한 사항인 경우에는 별지 제13호서식에 의하여 서면으로 의결할 수 있다. <개정 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ④ In cases where there are urgent circumstances making it difficult to convene a committee meeting, or in cases involving minor matters, a resolution may be made in writing using Form No. 13. <Amended Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ⑤사무총장ㆍ사무처장ㆍ사무국장ㆍ사무과장 및 위촉간사는 별지 제14호서식에 의하여 회의록을 작성하여야 한다. <개정 2010. 1. 25., 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The Secretary General, the Director of the Secretariat, the Director of the Secretariat, the Head of the Secretariat Division, and appointed secretaries shall prepare minutes of the meeting in accordance with Form No. 14. <Amended Jan. 25, 2010; Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ⑥회의록에는 위원장ㆍ상임위원 및 제5항의 작성자가 서명 또는 날인하며, 다음 회의에 보고하여야 한다. <개정 1994. 3. 2., 2005. 8. 4., 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Chairperson, Standing Committee Members, and the person who prepared the minutes under Paragraph 5 shall sign or seal the minutes, and they shall be reported at the next meeting. <Amended Mar. 2, 1994; Aug. 4, 2005; Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제4항부터 제6항까지에도 불구하고 개표록ㆍ집계록ㆍ선거록 등 별도의 서식이 있는 경우에는 의결록ㆍ회의록 서식을 해당 서식으로 대신할 수 있다. <신설 2022. 11. 30.>
rows.text_en: ⑦ Notwithstanding Paragraphs 4 through 6, if separate forms exist for vote counting records, tally records, election records, etc., the forms for resolution records and meeting minutes may be substituted for such forms. <Newly added Nov. 30, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(실비보상) ①각급 선거관리위원회의 위원 및 위촉된 간사ㆍ서기ㆍ선거사무종사원(이하 “위촉직원”이라 한다)에 대한 일당 ㆍ여비 기타의 실비보상은 다음 각호의 정하는 바에 의한다. <개정 1994. 3. 2., 1998. 10. 26.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Reimbursement of Actual Expenses) ① Daily allowances, travel expenses, and other reimbursement of actual expenses for members of election management committees at all levels and appointed secretaries, clerks, and election officials (hereinafter referred to as “appointed staff”) shall be as prescribed in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 2, 1994; Oct. 26, 1998>

rows.source_ko: 1. 각급 선거관리위원회위원 및 위촉직원이 공무로 여행할 때에는 예산의 범위안에서 별표 3의 지급기준에 따라 공무원여비규정 별표 2ㆍ별표 3 및 별표 4의 해당정액을 지급한다. 다만, 공무원인 위원과 위촉직원에 대하여는 그 본직에서 받는 여비액이 이 규칙에 의하여 지급되는 여비액보다 많은 경우에는 그 많은 여비액에 의한다.
rows.text_en: 1. When members of election management committees at all levels and appointed staff members travel on official business, they shall be paid the applicable fixed amounts specified in Annexes 2, 3, and 4 of the Regulations on Travel Expenses for Public Officials, in accordance with the payment standards in Annex 3, within the limits of the budget. However, for members and appointed staff members who are public officials, if the amount of travel expenses received in their primary position is greater than the amount of travel expenses paid under this rule, the greater amount shall apply.

rows.source_ko: 2. 각급 선거관리위원회위원(상임위원은 제외한다)과 위촉직원이 위원회에 출석한 때 또는 선거사무에 종사한 때에는 예산의 범위안에서 별표 4의 정하는 바에 따라 수당을 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: 2. Members of election management committees at all levels (excluding standing members) and appointed staff may be paid allowances within the limits of the budget in accordance with the provisions of Annex 4 when they attend the committee or engage in election affairs.

rows.source_ko: ②구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회의 정당추천위원이 선거기간중 상근할 때에는 예산의 범위안에서 수당을 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Members recommended by political parties of the District, City, or County Election Commission who work full-time during the election period may be paid an allowance within the limits of the budget.

rows.source_ko: 제12조의2(소송지원심의위원회) ① 각급 선거관리위원회(인터넷선거보도심의위원회, 중앙선거방송토론위원회, 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회를 포함하며, 이하 이 조에서 같다)의 위원, 소속 공무원, 위촉직원이 선거관리위원회의 정당한 업무수행과 관련하여 피의자로서 수사를 받거나 민사ㆍ형사소송의 당사자가 된 경우 그 비용 지원 및 그 밖에 필요한 사항을 심의하기 위하여 중앙선거관리위원회에 소송지원심의위원회(이하 “심의위원회”라 한다)를 둔다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-2 (Litigation Support Deliberation Committee) ① A Litigation Support Deliberation Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Deliberation Committee”) shall be established at the Central Election Commission to deliberate on matters regarding the support of expenses and other necessary matters in cases where members of each level of election commission (including the Internet Election Reporting Deliberation Committee, the Central Election Broadcasting Debate Commission, and the Central Election Public Opinion Survey Deliberation Committee; hereinafter the same applies in this Article), affiliated public officials, or commissioned staff members are investigated as suspects or become parties to civil or criminal litigation in connection with the legitimate performance of duties by the election commission.

rows.source_ko: ② 심의위원회는 위원장을 포함한 7명 이내의 위원으로 구성하되, 위원장은 사무차장이 되고, 위원은 중앙선거관리위원회 소속 국장급 이상 공무원이나 변호사 또는 법학교수, 그 밖에 수사, 민사ㆍ형사소송 등 관련 분야에 학식과 경험이 풍부한 사람 중에서 사무총장이 임명 또는 위촉한다. 이 경우 소속 공무원이 아닌 자를 3명 이상 포함하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Deliberation Committee shall be composed of no more than seven members, including the Chairperson; the Chairperson shall be the Deputy Secretary-General, and the members shall be appointed or commissioned by the Secretary-General from among public officials of the National Election Commission at the director level or higher, lawyers or law professors, or other persons with extensive knowledge and experience in relevant fields such as investigation, civil or criminal proceedings. In this case, at least three persons who are not public officials must be included.

rows.source_ko: ③ 위원의 임기는 3년으로 하며, 연임할 수 있다. 다만, 공무원인 위원장 및 위원의 임기는 임명 당시의 직위에 재직 중인 기간으로 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The term of office for members shall be three years, and they may be reappointed. However, the term of office for a chairperson and members who are public officials shall be the period during which they hold their positions at the time of appointment.

rows.source_ko: ④ 심의위원회의 위원장은 위원회의를 소집하고, 심의위원회의 회의는 재적위원 과반수 출석으로 개의하고, 출석위원 과반수의 찬성으로 의결한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The chairperson of the deliberation committee shall convene a meeting of the committee, and the meeting of the deliberation committee shall be opened with the attendance of a majority of the registered members and decisions shall be made by the approval of a majority of the members present.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 심의위원회의 사무를 처리하기 위하여 간사 1명을 두며, 간사는 심의위원회의 위원장이 중앙선거관리위원회 소속 5급 이상 공무원 중에서 임명한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ One secretary shall be appointed to handle the affairs of the deliberation committee, and the secretary shall be appointed by the chairperson of the deliberation committee from among public officials of Grade 5 or higher belonging to the National Election Commission.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 심의위원회는 중앙선거관리위원회 훈령으로 정하는 바에 따라예산의 범위 내에서 제1항에 따른 비용을 지원하거나, 이미 지급한 비용의 환수를 결정할 수 있다. 이 경우 중앙선거관리위원회는 심의위원회의 결정에 따라 비용을 지급 또는 환수하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ The Deliberation Committee may decide to provide support for expenses under Paragraph 1 or to recover expenses already paid within the scope of the budget, as prescribed by the directive of the National Election Commission. In this case, the National Election Commission shall pay or recover the expenses in accordance with the decision of the Deliberation Committee.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 심의위원회의 구성ㆍ운영, 심의사항 및 기준, 지원범위, 위원에 대한 수당 및 그 밖에 심의위원회 운영에 필요한 사항은 중앙선거관리위원회 훈령으로 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ The composition and operation of the Deliberation Committee, matters and standards for deliberation, scope of support, allowances for members, and other matters necessary for the operation of the Deliberation Committee shall be determined by a directive of the National Election Commission.
[This Article Newly Inserted on Apr. 22, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(상시계도사업 위탁비의 교부) 중앙선거관리위원회는 법 제14조제3항의 규정에 의하여 상시계도를 위한 사업을 위탁할 경우에는 예산의 범위안에서 그 실시에 필요한 경비를 교부하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Disbursement of entrustment fees for continuous guidance projects) When the National Election Commission entrusts a project for continuous guidance pursuant to the provisions of Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Act, it shall disburse the expenses necessary for the implementation within the scope of the budget.

rows.source_ko: 제14조(다른 기관 소속공무원의 파견근무요청 등) ①법 제15조제15항의 규정에 의하여 각급 선거관리위원회가 국가기관 또는 지방자치단체의 소속공무원의 파견근무를 요청할 때에는 파견인원 및 파견기간 등을 미리 그 소속기관의 장과 협의하여야 한다. <개정 2005. 6. 25.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Request for Dispatch of Public Officials Belonging to Other Agencies, etc.) ① When an election commission at any level requests the dispatch of public officials belonging to a state agency or a local government pursuant to the provisions of Article 15, Paragraph 15 of the Act, it shall consult with the head of the affiliated agency in advance regarding the number of personnel to be dispatched and the duration of the dispatch, etc. <Amended June 25, 2005>

rows.source_ko: ②각급선거관리위원회는 다른 기관 소속공무원을 파견받은 때에는 지체없이 그 직근 상급선거관리위원회에 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When an election commission at any level receives a public official from another agency, it shall report to the immediate superior election commission without delay.

[This Article was newly added on Apr. 21, 1990.]
[Former Article 14 was moved to Article 15 on Apr. 21, 1990.]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(위촉직원의 위촉) ①구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원장은 법 제15조제16항의 규정에 따라 당해 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동 소속 6급이하 공무원 중에서 간사ㆍ서기를 위촉한다. 다만, 선거일전 3일부터 선거일까지의 기간에는 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회 위원장이 이를 할 수 있다. 이 경우 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회 위원장은 위촉상황을 즉시 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원장에게 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Appointment of Secretaries and Clerks) ① The Chairperson of the District, City, or County Election Commission shall appoint secretaries and clerks from among public officials of Grade 6 or lower belonging to the relevant Eup, Myeon, or Dong, in accordance with the provisions of Article 15, Paragraph 16 of the Act. However, during the period from three days prior to the election day to the election day, the Chairperson of the Eup, Myeon, or Dong Election Commission may do so. In this case, the Chairperson of the Eup, Myeon, or Dong Election Commission shall immediately report the status of appointment to the Chairperson of the District, City, or County Election Commission.

rows.source_ko: ②각급선거관리위원회 위원장은 제1항의 간사ㆍ서기의 위촉을 위하여 해당 구ㆍ시ㆍ군 또는 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동의 장에게 대상자의 추천을 요청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The chairperson of each level of election management committee may request the head of the relevant district, city, county, or town, township, or neighborhood to recommend candidates for the appointment of the secretary and clerk referred to in Paragraph 1.

rows.source_ko: ③구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원장이 위촉직원을 위촉한 때에는 지체 없이 다음 각 호에서 정하는 바에 따라 사무를 처리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the chairperson of a district, city, or county election commission has appointed an employee, he or she shall handle affairs without delay in accordance with the provisions of each of the following subparagraphs.
2. Registration in the Register of Secretaries and Clerks pursuant to Form No. 16

rows.source_ko: 3. 당해 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회 위원장 및 구ㆍ시ㆍ군의 장에게 명단의 통보
rows.text_en: 3. Notification of the list to the chairpersons of the relevant Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees and the heads of the Gu, Si, and Gun
[Wholly Amended Aug. 4, 2005]

rows.source_ko: 제15조의2(위촉직원의 해촉) ①각급선거관리위원회 위원장이 위촉직원을 해촉하고자 하는 때에는 그 소속기관의 장과 협의하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 15-2 (Dismissal of Appointed Staff) ① When the chairperson of an election management committee at any level intends to dismiss an appointed staff member, he/she shall consult with the head of the affiliated agency.

rows.source_ko: ②제15조제1항의 규정은 간사ㆍ서기의 해촉에 준용한다. 이 경우 “위촉”은 “해촉”으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② The provisions of Article 15, Paragraph 1 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the dismissal of secretaries and clerks. In this case, “appointment” shall be deemed “dismissal.”

rows.source_ko: ③위촉직원이 그 소속 행정기관에서 다른 행정기관으로 전출 또는 전보되거나 해임된 때에는 해촉된 것으로 본다. 다만, 제15조제1항 단서의 규정에 의하여 간사ㆍ서기로 위촉된 공무원이 당해 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동으로 전입하거나, 당해 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동 소속 간사ㆍ서기가 관할 구ㆍ시ㆍ군으로 전출된 경우에는 그러하지 아니하다.
rows.text_en: ③ When an appointed employee is transferred or reassigned from their affiliated administrative agency to another administrative agency, or is dismissed, they shall be deemed to have been relieved of their appointment. However, this shall not apply in cases where a public official appointed as a secretary or clerk pursuant to the proviso of Article 15, Paragraph 1 is transferred to the relevant Eup, Myeon, or Dong, or where a secretary or clerk belonging to the relevant Eup, Myeon, or Dong is transferred to the competent Gu, Si, or Gun.

rows.source_ko: ④구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 위원장은 간사ㆍ서기가 위법ㆍ부당한 행위로 선거의 공정성을 현저히 침해한 때에는 지체 없이 해촉하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The chairperson of the district, city, or county election commission shall dismiss the secretary or clerk without delay if the secretary or clerk significantly infringes upon the fairness of the election through illegal or improper acts.
[This Article was newly established on August 4, 2005.]

rows.source_ko: 제16조(업무의 일시적 대행) ①구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 또는 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회가 천재ㆍ지변 등 기타 불가피한 사유로 그 기능을 수행할 수 없는 때에는 직근 상급선거관리위원회는 다른 선거관리위원회로 하여금 당해 선거관리위원회의 기능이 회복될 때까지 그 사무를 대행하게 할 수 있다. 이 경우 대행할 업무의 범위도 함께 정하여야 한다. <개정 2005. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Temporary Delegation of Duties) ① Where a District, City, or County Election Commission or an Eup, Myeon, or Dong Election Commission is unable to perform its functions due to natural disasters, natural calamities, or other unavoidable circumstances, the immediate superior Election Commission may have another Election Commission perform its duties on its behalf until the functions of the said Election Commission are restored. In this case, the scope of the duties to be performed on its behalf shall also be determined. <Amended Aug. 4, 2005>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의하여 대행 선거관리위원회와 그 업무의 범위를 정한 때에는 지체없이 이를 공고하고 상급선거관리위원회에 보고하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the acting election management committee and the scope of its duties are determined pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1, such determination shall be announced without delay and reported to the superior election management committee.

[This Article was newly added on Dec. 31, 1987.]
[Moved from Article 15 on Apr. 21, 1990.]

rows.text_en: ① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

Addenda <Rule No. 60 of the National Election Commission, Dec. 31, 1987>

rows.source_ko: ②(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시의 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 상임위원은 이 규칙에 따라 지명된 것으로 보되, 그 지명기간은 종전의 예(5년)에 의한다. 이 규칙 시행후 1988년 2월 24일까지 지명되는 상임위원의 지명기간도 또한 같다. 다만, 1983년 2월 4일 이전에 지명된 상임위원은 1988년 4월 30일에 그 지명이 해제되는 것으로 한다. <개정 1988. 2. 29.>
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures) Standing members of the City/Provincial Election Commissions existing at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been appointed in accordance with this Rule, provided that the term of appointment shall be in accordance with the previous precedent (5 years). rows.source_ko: ②(제천시갑선거관리위원회에 대한 경과조치) 제천시갑선거관리위원회는 [별표 1]의 개정규정에 불구하고 제천시선거관리위원회가 설치될 때까지 존속하며 그 기간중 제천시선거관리위원회의 업무를 관장한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional measures concerning the Jecheon-si Gap Election Management Committee) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of [Attached Table 1], the Jecheon-si Gap Election Management Committee shall continue to exist until the Jecheon-si Election Management Committee is established and shall oversee the affairs of the Jecheon-si Election Management Committee during that period.

rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures Concerning Jurisdiction) Until the Ulsan Nam-gu Eul Election Management Committee newly established under this Rule is established, the Ulsan Nam-gu Gap Election Management Committee shall have jurisdiction over the said Election Management Committee.

rows.source_ko: ③(두개 이상의 행정구역에 걸친 국회의원지역선거구 선거관리에 관한 경과조치) 1996년 4월 11일 실시하는 국회의원선거(보궐선거 등을 포함한다)에 있어서 북구ㆍ강서구갑선거구관할선거관리위원회를 북구선거관리위원회로, 북구ㆍ강서구을선거구관할선거관리위원회를 강서구선거관리위원회로, 해운대구ㆍ기장군갑선거구관할선거관리위원회를 해운대구선거관리위원회로, 해운대구ㆍ기장군을선거구관할선거관리위원회를 기장군선거관리위원회로, 계양구ㆍ강화군갑선거구관할선거관리위원회를 계양구선거관리위원회로, 계양구ㆍ강화군을선거구관할선거관리위원회를 강화군선거관리위원회로, 목포시ㆍ신안군갑선거구관할선거관리위원회를 목포시선거관리위원회로, 목포시ㆍ신안군을선거구관할선거관리위원회를 신안군선거관리위원회로 각각 지정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Transitional measures concerning election management for National Assembly constituencies spanning two or more administrative districts) In the National Assembly election (including by-elections, etc.) to be held on April 11, 1996, the Election Management Committee with jurisdiction over the Buk-gu and Gangseo-gu A constituency shall be changed to the Buk-gu Election Management Committee; the Election Management Committee with jurisdiction over the Buk-gu and Gangseo-gu B constituency shall be changed to the Gangseo-gu Election Management Committee; the Election Management Committee with jurisdiction over the Haeundae-gu and Gijang-gun A constituency shall be changed to the Haeundae-gu Election Management Committee; the Election Management Committee with jurisdiction over the Haeundae-gu and Gijang-gun B constituency shall be changed to the Gijang-gun Election Management Committee; the Election Management Committee with jurisdiction over the Gyeyang-gu and Ganghwa-gun A constituency shall be changed to the Gyeyang-gu Election Management Committee; the Election Management Committee with jurisdiction over the Gyeyang-gu and Ganghwa-gun B constituency shall be changed to the Ganghwa-gun Election Management Committee; and the Election Management Committee with jurisdiction over the Mokpo-si and Sinan-gun A constituency shall be changed to the Mokpo-si Election Management Committee. The election management committee with jurisdiction over the Mokpo City and Sinan County electoral districts is designated as the Sinan County Election Management Committee, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 (상임위원 지명기간에 관한 특례) 이 규칙 시행당시 재임중인 시ㆍ도선거관리위원회 상임위원은 이 규칙 시행일에 지명이 해제된 것으로 보되, 다음 각호에 의한 잔여재임기간의 범위안에서 이 규칙 시행일에 새로이 지명하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Special Provisions Concerning the Period of Appointment for Standing Members) Standing members of the City/Provincial Election Commissions who are in office at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have their appointments revoked on the effective date of this Rule; provided, however, that new appointments must be made on the effective date of this Rule within the scope of the remaining term of office as stipulated in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 종전의 제9조제2항의 규정에 의한 지명일(이하 “최초지명일”이라 한다)로부터 3년 이상 재임(제9조제3항의 규정에 의한 재임기간을 포함한다. 이하 같다)한 자는 이 규칙 시행일로부터 1년까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: 1. A person who has served for three years or more from the date of designation pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the former rule (hereinafter referred to as the “date of initial designation”) (including the period of service pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 3; hereinafter the same applies) shall serve for up to one year from the effective date of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 2. 최초지명일로부터 1년 이상 3년 미만 재임한 자는 이 규칙 시행일로부터 그 합산한 기간이 4년에 달한 때까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Persons who have served for more than one year but less than three years from the date of initial designation shall be considered to have served until the combined period reaches four years from the effective date of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 3. 최초지명일로부터 1년 미만 재임한 자는 이 규칙 시행일로부터 3년에 달한 때까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: 3. Persons who have served for less than one year from the date of initial appointment shall serve until three years have passed from the effective date of this rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조 (폐지되는 위원회의 처분 등 승계) 이 규칙 시행전에 폐지되는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 또는 그 위원장이 행한 처분 기타의 행위는 폐지되는 위원회의 구역을 관할하는 신설되는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 또는 그 위원장이 행한 처분 기타의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Succession to Dispositions, etc. by an Abolished Committee) Any disposition or other act taken by a District, City, or County Election Commission or its Chairperson that is repealed prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by a newly established District, City, or County Election Commission or its Chairperson that has jurisdiction over the area of the repealed Commission.

rows.source_ko: 제4조 (사무의 승계) 이 규칙 시행당시 폐지되는 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회의 업무는 폐지되는 위원회의 구역을 관할하는 신설된 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회가 승계한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Succession of Duties) The duties of the district, city, and county election commissions that are abolished at the time of enforcement of this rule shall be succeeded by the newly established district, city, and county election commissions that have jurisdiction over the area of the abolished commissions.

rows.source_ko: 제5조 (투표구선거관리위원회 위원에 대한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 폐지되는 구ㆍ시ㆍ선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임중인 관할투표구선거관리위원회 위원은 폐지되는 위원회의 구역을 관할하는 신설된 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회가 위촉한 것으로 보되, 그 잔여기간중 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Transitional Measures concerning Members of the Polling District Election Management Committee) Members of the competent polling district election management committee who were appointed by the district, city, or election management committee that is abolished at the time of the enforcement of this rule shall be deemed to have been appointed by the newly established district, city, or county election management committee that has jurisdiction over the area of the abolished committee, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제6조 (소속공무원에 대한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 폐지되는 구ㆍ시선거관리위원회에 근무하는 소속공무원은 별도 발령시까지 폐지되는 위원회의 구역을 관할하는 신설된 구ㆍ시ㆍ군선거관리위원회의 소속공무원으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Transitional Measures for Affiliated Officials) Affiliated officials working for the District or City Election Management Committee that is abolished at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to be affiliated officials of the newly established District, City, or County Election Management Committee having jurisdiction over the area of the abolished Committee until a separate appointment is issued.

rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures concerning Members of Polling District Election Management Committees, etc.) Members and appointed staff of competent polling district election management committees who were appointed by the Ansan City Election Management Committee and are in office at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been appointed by the newly established Ansan City Danwon-gu Election Management Committee and Ansan City Sangnok-gu Election Management Committee, respectively, having jurisdiction over the relevant districts, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their terms.

However, the regulations concerning the establishment of the Gyeryong City Election Commission shall take effect on September 19, 2003, and the regulations concerning the change of names of the Yangju City Election Commission and the Pocheon City Election Commission shall take effect on October 19, 2003.

rows.source_ko: ②(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 괴산군선거관리위원회 및 논산시선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임중인 투표구선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 의하여 설치되는 증평군선거관리위원회 및 계룡시선거관리위원회 관할구역의 투표구선거관리위원회위원은 각각 증평군선거관리위원회 및 계룡시선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 잔임기간 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures) Among the members of the polling station election management committees appointed by the Goesan-gun Election Commission and the Nonsan-si Election Commission and currently in office at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, the members of the polling station election management committees within the jurisdiction of the Jeungpyeong-gun Election Commission and the Gyeryong-si Election Commission established pursuant to this Rule shall be deemed as members appointed by the Jeungpyeong-gun Election Commission and the Gyeryong-si Election Commission, respectively, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their terms.

rows.source_ko: ③(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행전에 괴산군선거관리위원회 및 논산시선거관리위원회가 증평군선거관리위원회 및 계룡시선거관리위원회의 관할지역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분 기타의 행위는 각각 증평군선거관리위원회 및 계룡시선거관리위원회가 행한 처분 기타의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act taken by the Goesan-gun Election Commission and the Nonsan-si Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Jeungpyeong-gun Election Commission and the Gyeryong-si Election Commission shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by the Jeungpyeong-gun Election Commission and the Gyeryong-si Election Commission, respectively.
Addenda <Rule No. 203 of the National Election Commission, Oct. 24, 2003>
① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on December 1, 2003.

rows.source_ko: ②(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 수원시팔달구선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임중인 투표구선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 의하여 설치되는 수원시영통구선거관리위원회 관할구역의 투표구선거관리위원회위원은 수원시영통구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 잔임기간동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures) Among the members of the polling station election management committees appointed by the Suwon City Paldal-gu Election Management Committee and currently in office at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, the members of the polling station election management committees within the jurisdiction of the Suwon City Yeongtong-gu Election Management Committee established pursuant to this Rule shall be deemed to be members appointed by the Suwon City Yeongtong-gu Election Management Committee and shall remain in office for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: ③(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행전에 수원시팔달구선거관리위원회가 수원시영통구선거관리위원회의 관할지역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분 기타의 행위는 수원시영통구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분 기타의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act taken by the Suwon City Paldal-gu Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdiction of the Suwon City Yeongtong-gu Election Commission shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by the Suwon City Yeongtong-gu Election Commission.
Addenda <Rule No. 215 of the National Election Commission, Mar. 12, 2004>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
Addenda <Rule No. 237 of the National Election Commission, May 12, 2005>
① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on May 16, 2005.

rows.source_ko: ②(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행전의 고양시일산구선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임중인 투표구선거관리위원회위원으로서 이 규칙 시행으로 설치되는 고양시일산동구선거관리위원회 및 고양시일산서구선거관리위원회의 관할구역안에 있는 투표구선거관리위원회위원은 각각 고양시일산동구선거관리위원회 및 고양시일산서구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 잔임기간 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures) Members of the polling station election management committees who were appointed and are currently serving as members of the Goyang City Ilsan-gu Election Management Committee prior to the enforcement of this Rule, and whose polling station election management committees are located within the jurisdiction of the Goyang City Ilsan Dong-gu Election Management Committee and the Goyang City Ilsan Seo-gu Election Management Committee established pursuant to the enforcement of this Rule, shall be deemed as members appointed by the Goyang City Ilsan Dong-gu Election Management Committee and the Goyang City Ilsan Seo-gu Election Management Committee, respectively, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their terms.

rows.source_ko: ③(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행전에 고양시일산구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분 기타의 행위는 그 관할구역에 따라 각각 고양시일산동구선거관리위원회 및 고양시일산서구관리위원회가 행한 처분 기타의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act performed by the Goyang-si Ilsan-gu Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been performed by the Goyang-si Ilsan-dong-gu Election Commission and the Goyang-si Ilsan-seo-gu Election Commission, respectively, according to their respective jurisdictions.
Addenda <Rule No. 239 of the National Election Commission, June 25, 2005>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <중앙선거관리위원회규칙 제244호, 2005. 8. 4.> (선거관리위원회법 시행규칙 등 일부개정규칙)
rows.text_en: Addenda <National Election Commission Rule No. 244, Aug. 4, 2005> (Rules Partially Amending the Enforcement Rules of the National Election Commission Act, etc.)
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
Addenda <Rule No. 248 of the National Election Commission, Oct. 28, 2005>
① (Enforcement Date) This rule shall take effect on October 31, 2005.

rows.source_ko: ②(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 용인시선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임중인 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 의하여 설치되는 용인시처인구선거관리위원회, 용인시수지구선거관리위원회 및 용인시기흥구선거관리위원회 관할구역의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원은 각각 용인시처인구선거관리위원회, 용인시수지구선거관리위원회 및 용인시기흥구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 잔임기간 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: ② (Transitional Measures) Among the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees who were appointed by the Yongin City Election Management Committee and are currently in office at the time of the enforcement of this rule, the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees within the jurisdiction of the Yongin City Cheoin-gu Election Management Committee, Yongin City Suji-gu Election Management Committee, and Yongin City Giheung-gu Election Management Committee established under this rule shall be deemed as members appointed by the Yongin City Cheoin-gu Election Management Committee, Yongin City Suji-gu Election Management Committee, and Yongin City Giheung-gu Election Management Committee, respectively, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: ③(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행 전에 용인시선거관리위원회가 용인시처인구선거관리위원회, 용인시수지구선거관리위원회 및 용인시기흥구선거관리위원회의 관할지역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분 그 밖의 행위는 각각 용인시처인구선거관리위원회, 용인시수지구선거관리위원회 및 용인시기흥구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: ③ (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act performed by the Yongin City Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Yongin City Cheoin-gu Election Commission, the Yongin City Suji-gu Election Commission, and the Yongin City Giheung-gu Election Commission shall be deemed as a disposition or other act performed by the Yongin City Cheoin-gu Election Commission, the Yongin City Suji-gu Election Commission, and the Yongin City Giheung-gu Election Commission, respectively.
Addenda <National Election Commission Rule No. 253, Dec. 19, 2005> (Rules Partially Amending the Rules on Performance Evaluation of National Election Commission Officials, etc.)
This rule shall take effect on January 1, 2006.
Addenda <Rule No. 262 of the National Election Commission, June 12, 2006>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This rule shall enter into force on July 1, 2006.

rows.source_ko: 제2조 (폐지되는 시ㆍ군선거관리위원회의 처분등 승계) 이 규칙 시행 전에 폐지되는 시ㆍ군선거관리위원회가 행한 처분 그 밖의 행위는 새로 그 구역을 관할하는 시선거관리위원회가 행한 처분 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Succession to Dispositions, etc. by City/County Election Commissions Abolished) Any dispositions or other acts taken by a City/County Election Commission abolished prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been taken by the City Election Commission newly having jurisdiction over the area.

rows.source_ko: 제3조 (읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회의 위원에 대한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 폐지되는 시ㆍ군선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임중인 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회의 위원은 새로 그 구역을 관할하는 시선거관리위원회가 위촉한 것으로 보되, 그 잔여 임기동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning Members of Eup, Myeon, and Dong Election Management Committees) Members of Eup, Myeon, and Dong Election Management Committees who were appointed by the City or County Election Management Committee that is abolished at the time of the enforcement of this rule and are currently in office shall be deemed to have been appointed by the City Election Management Committee having jurisdiction over the area, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제4조 (소속공무원에 대한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 폐지되는 시ㆍ군선거관리위원회 소속공무원은 별도 발령시까지 새로 그 구역을 관할하는 시선거관리위원회 소속공무원으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures for Officials) Officials belonging to the City or County Election Commission that is abolished at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to belong to the newly competent City Election Commission until separate appointments are made.
Addenda <Rule No. 272 of the National Election Commission, Jan. 29, 2007>

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날로부터 20일을 경과함으로서 효력을 발생한다.
rows.text_en: This rule takes effect 20 days after the date of promulgation.
Addenda <Rule No. 292 of the National Election Commission, Feb. 29, 2008>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
Addenda <Rule No. 298 of the National Election Commission, June 23, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This rule shall enter into force on July 1, 2008.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행당시 천안시선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임중인 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 의하여 설치되는 천안시서북구선거관리위원회 및 천안시동남구선거관리위원회 관할구역안의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원은 각각 천안시서북구선거관리위원회 및 천안시동남구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 잔임기간 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures) Among the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees who were appointed by the Cheonan City Election Management Committee and are currently in office at the time of the enforcement of this rule, the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees within the jurisdiction of the Cheonan City Northwest District Election Management Committee and the Cheonan City Southeast District Election Management Committee established pursuant to this rule shall be deemed as members appointed by the Cheonan City Northwest District Election Management Committee and the Cheonan City Southeast District Election Management Committee, respectively, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행 전에 천안시선거관리위원회가 천안시 서북구선거관리위원회 및 천안시동남구선거관리위원회의 관할지역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분 그 밖의 행위는 각각 천안시서북구선거관리위원회 및 천안시동남구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act taken by the Cheonan City Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Cheonan City Seobuk-gu Election Commission and the Cheonan City Dongnam-gu Election Commission shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by the Cheonan City Seobuk-gu Election Commission and the Cheonan City Dongnam-gu Election Commission, respectively.
Addenda <Rule No. 313 of the National Election Commission, Nov. 20, 2009>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 부      칙 <중앙선거관리위원회규칙 제319호, 2010. 1. 25.> (선거관리위원회 사무기구에 관한 규칙)
rows.text_en: Addenda <Rule No. 319 of the National Election Commission, Jan. 25, 2010> (Rules on the Secretariat of the National Election Commission)

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 omitted

rows.source_ko: 제3조(다른 규칙의 개정) ① 선거관리위원회법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Amendment of Other Rules) ① Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Election Commission Act is amended as follows.
In Article 11, Paragraph 4, “Secretary General” shall be changed to “Director of the Secretariat/Secretary General”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제4호 서식 중 “○○(국ㆍ과)장 인”을 “○○(처ㆍ국ㆍ과)장 인”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Form No. 4, “Seal of the Head of ○○ (Bureau/Division)” shall be changed to “Seal of the Head of ○○ (Department/Bureau/Division)”.

rows.source_ko: 별지 제13호 및 제14호 서식 중 “사무총장(사무국장ㆍ사무과장ㆍ위촉간사)”을 각각 “사무총장(사무처장ㆍ사무국장ㆍ사무과장ㆍ위촉간사)”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Forms No. 13 and No. 14, “Secretary General (Director of the Secretariat, Head of the Secretariat Division, Appointed Secretary)” shall be changed to “Secretary General (Head of the Secretariat, Director of the Secretariat, Head of the Secretariat Division, Appointed Secretary)”, respectively.
② through ⑤ omitted
Addenda <Rule No. 327 of the National Election Commission, Feb. 26, 2010>
This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation.
Addenda <Rule No. 335 of the National Election Commission, July 26, 2010>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This rule shall enter into force on August 1, 2010.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 창원시선거관리위원회, 마산시선거관리위원회 및 진해시선거관리위원회가 각각 위촉하여 재임중인 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 따라 설치되는 창원시의창구선거관리위원회, 창원시성산구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산합포구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산회원구선거관리위원회 및 창원시진해구선거관리위원회 관할구역안의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원은 각각 창원시의창구선거관리위원회, 창원시성산구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산합포구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산회원구선거관리위원회 및 창원시진해구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 잔임기간 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures) Among the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees who were appointed and are currently serving as commissioners by the Changwon City Election Management Committee, the Masan City Election Management Committee, and the Jinhae City Election Management Committee at the time of the enforcement of this rule, the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees within the jurisdiction of the Changwon City Uichang-gu Election Management Committee, Changwon City Seongsan-gu Election Management Committee, Changwon City Masan Happo-gu Election Management Committee, Changwon City Masan Hoewon-gu Election Management Committee, and Changwon City Jinhae-gu Election Management Committee established pursuant to this rule shall be deemed as commissioners appointed by the Changwon City Uichang-gu Election Management Committee, Changwon City Seongsan-gu Election Management Committee, Changwon City Masan Happo-gu Election Management Committee, Changwon City Masan Hoewon-gu Election Management Committee, and Changwon City Jinhae-gu Election Management Committee, respectively, and shall serve for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행 전에 창원시선거관리위원회, 마산시선거관리위원회 및 진해시선거관리위원회가 창원시의창구선거관리위원회, 창원시성산구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산합포구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산회원구선거관리위원회 및 창원시진해구선거관리위원회의 관할지역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위는 각각 창원시의창구선거관리위원회, 창원시성산구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산합포구선거관리위원회, 창원시마산회원구선거관리위원회 및 창원시진해구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act taken by the Changwon City Election Commission, the Masan City Election Commission, and the Jinhae City Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Changwon City Uichang-gu Election Commission, the Changwon City Seongsan-gu Election Commission, the Changwon City Masan Happo-gu Election Commission, the Changwon City Masan Hoewon-gu Election Commission, and the Changwon City Jinhae-gu Election Commission shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by the Changwon City Uichang-gu Election Commission, the Changwon City Seongsan-gu Election Commission, the Changwon City Masan Happo-gu Election Commission, the Changwon City Masan Hoewon-gu Election Commission, and the Changwon City Jinhae-gu Election Commission, respectively.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Establishment of the Bucheon City Election Commission) The Bucheon City Election Commission pursuant to the amended provisions of Annex 1 shall be established on January 1, 2017.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(구선거관리위원회에 대한 경과조치) 부천시원미구선거관리위원회, 부천시소사구선거관리위원회 및 부천시오정구선거관리위원회는 부천시선거관리위원회가 설치될 때까지 존속하며, 그 기간 중 부천시선거관리위원회의 업무를 관장한다. 이 경우 부천시원미구선거관리위원회는 부천시갑선거관리위원회로, 부천시소사구선거관리위원회는 부천시을선거관리위원회로, 부천시오정구선거관리위원회는 부천시병선거관리위원회로 그 명칭이 변경된 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning District Election Commissions) The Bucheon City Wonmi-gu Election Commission, the Bucheon City Sosa-gu Election Commission, and the Bucheon City Ojeong-gu Election Commission shall continue to exist until the Bucheon City Election Commission is established, and shall oversee the affairs of the Bucheon City Election Commission during that period. In this case, the Bucheon City Wonmi-gu Election Commission shall be deemed to have been renamed the Bucheon City Gap Election Commission, the Bucheon City Sosa-gu Election Commission the Bucheon City Eul Election Commission, and the Bucheon City Ojeong-gu Election Commission the Bucheon City Byeong Election Commission.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(동선거관리위원회의 위원에 대한 경과조치) 부천시선거관리위원회가 설치되는 당시 부천시갑선거관리위원회, 부천시을선거관리위원회 및 부천시병선거관리위원회가 각각 위촉하여 재임 중인 동선거관리위원회 위원은 부천시선거관리위원회가 위촉한 것으로 보되, 그 잔여임기 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Members of the Election Commission) Members of the Election Commission who were appointed and are serving in office by the Bucheon City Gap Election Commission, Bucheon City Eul Election Commission, and Bucheon City Byeong Election Commission, respectively, at the time the Bucheon City Election Commission is established shall be deemed to have been appointed by the Bucheon City Election Commission, and shall serve for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(처분의 승계) 부천시선거관리위원회가 설치되는 당시 부천시갑선거관리위원회, 부천시을선거관리위원회 및 부천시병선거관리위원회가 각각 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위는 부천시선거관리위원회가 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act taken by the Bucheon City Gap Election Management Committee, the Bucheon City Eul Election Management Committee, and the Bucheon City Byeong Election Management Committee, respectively, at the time of the establishment of the Bucheon City Election Management Committee shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by the Bucheon City Election Management Committee.

rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Appointment Period of Standing Members of City/Provincial Election Commissions) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 9-2, the appointment period of standing members of city/provincial election commissions who are in office prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be governed by the former provisions.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(시선거관리위원회 설치에 따른 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회 위원 위촉 등에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 부천시선거관리위원회 및 화성시선거관리위원회가 각각 위촉하여 재임 중인 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 따라 설치되는 부천시갑선거관리위원회, 부천시을선거관리위원회, 화성시갑선거관리위원회 및 화성시을선거관리위원회 관할구역 안의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원은 각각 부천시갑선거관리위원회, 부천시을선거관리위원회, 화성시갑선거관리위원회 및 화성시을선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 잔여임기 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures concerning the Appointment, etc. of Members of Eup, Myeon, and Dong Election Management Committees following the Establishment of City Election Management Committees) Among the members of Eup, Myeon, and Dong Election Management Committees who were appointed by the Bucheon City Election Management Committee and the Hwaseong City Election Management Committee and are currently in office at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, the members of Eup, Myeon, and Dong Election Management Committees within the jurisdictional areas of the Bucheon City Gap Election Management Committee, Bucheon City Eul Election Management Committee, Hwaseong City Gap Election Management Committee, and Hwaseong City Eul Election Management Committee established pursuant to this Rule shall be deemed as members appointed by the Bucheon City Gap Election Management Committee, Bucheon City Eul Election Management Committee, Hwaseong City Gap Election Management Committee, and Hwaseong City Eul Election Management Committee, respectively, and shall remain in office for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행 전에 부천시선거관리위원회 및 화성시선거관리위원회가 부천시갑선거관리위원회, 부천시을선거관리위원회, 화성시갑선거관리위원회 및 화성시을선거관리위원회의 관할지역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위는 각각 부천시갑선거관리위원회, 부천시을선거관리위원회, 화성시갑선거관리위원회 및 화성시을선거관리위원회가 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act taken by the Bucheon City Election Commission and the Hwaseong City Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Bucheon City Gap Election Commission, Bucheon City Eul Election Commission, Hwaseong City Gap Election Commission, and Hwaseong City Eul Election Commission shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by the Bucheon City Gap Election Commission, Bucheon City Eul Election Commission, Hwaseong City Gap Election Commission, and Hwaseong City Eul Election Commission, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(다른 규칙의 폐지) 각급선거관리위원회회의규칙(중앙선거관리위원회규칙 제52호)을 폐지한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Repeal of Other Rules) The Rules on Meetings of Election Commissions at Each Level (Rule No. 52 of the Central Election Commission) are hereby repealed.

rows.text_en: This rule shall take effect from the date of promulgation, but shall apply to allowances paid on or after January 1, 2023.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2024년 1월 1일부터 시행한다. 다만, 별표 1, 별표 2, 별표 2-2, 별표 2-3, 별표 2-4의 전북특별자치도 명칭과 그 관할구역에 관한 개정규정은 「전북특별자치도 설치 등에 관한 특별법」 시행일인 2024년 1월 18일부터 시행한다.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(군위군선거관리위원회 위원 위촉권자에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 경상북도선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임 중인 군위군선거관리위원회위원은 대구광역시선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 남은 임기 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Appointing Authority of Members of the Gunwi-gun Election Commission) Members of the Gunwi-gun Election Commission who are serving after being appointed by the Gyeongsangbuk-do Election Commission at the time of the enforcement of this rule shall be deemed to be members appointed by the Daegu Metropolitan City Election Commission, and shall serve for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(동선거관리위원회 설치에 따른 위원임기에 관한 경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 부천시갑선거관리위원회 및 부천시을선거관리위원회가 각각 위촉하여 재임 중인 동선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 따라 설치되는 부천시원미구선거관리위원회, 부천시소사구선거관리위원회, 부천시오정구선거관리위원회의 관할구역 안의 동선거관리위원회위원은 각각 부천시원미구선거관리위원회, 부천시소사구선거관리위원회, 부천시오정구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 남은 임기 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning the Term of Office of Members Following the Establishment of Dong-gu Election Management Committees) Among the members of the Dong-gu Election Management Committees who were appointed by the Bucheon-si Gap Election Management Committee and the Bucheon-si Eul Election Management Committee and are currently serving at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, the members of the Dong-gu Election Management Committees within the jurisdiction of the Bucheon-si Wonmi-gu Election Management Committee, the Bucheon-si Sosa-gu Election Management Committee, and the Bucheon-si Ojeong-gu Election Management Committee established pursuant to this Rule shall be deemed as members appointed by the Bucheon-si Wonmi-gu Election Management Committee, the Bucheon-si Sosa-gu Election Management Committee, and the Bucheon-si Ojeong-gu Election Management Committee, respectively, and shall serve for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(처분의 승계) 이 규칙 시행 전에 부천시갑선거관리위원회 및 부천시을선거관리위원회가 부천시원미구선거관리위원회, 부천시소사구선거관리위원회, 부천시오정구선거관리위원회의 관할구역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위는 각각 부천시원미구선거관리위원회, 부천시소사구선거관리위원회, 부천시오정구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Succession of Dispositions) Any disposition or other act taken by the Bucheon City Gap Election Commission and the Bucheon City Eul Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Bucheon City Wonmi-gu Election Commission, the Bucheon City Sosa-gu Election Commission, and the Bucheon City Ojeong-gu Election Commission shall be deemed as a disposition or other act taken by the Bucheon City Wonmi-gu Election Commission, the Bucheon City Sosa-gu Election Commission, and the Bucheon City Ojeong-gu Election Commission, respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 인천광역시 중구선거관리위원회ㆍ동구선거관리위원회ㆍ서구선거관리위원회가 위촉하여 재임 중인 동선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 따라 설치되는 영종구선거관리위원회ㆍ제물포구선거관리위원회ㆍ검단구선거관리위원회 관할구역 안의 동선거관리위원회위원은 각각 영종구선거관리위원회ㆍ제물포구선거관리위원회ㆍ검단구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 남은 임기 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures) Among the members of the Dong-gu Election Commissions who were appointed by the Incheon Metropolitan City Jung-gu Election Commission, Dong-gu Election Commission, and Seo-gu Election Commission and are currently serving at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, the members of the Dong-gu Election Commissions located within the jurisdictional areas of the Yeongjong-gu Election Commission, Jemulpo-gu Election Commission, and Geomdan-gu Election Commission established pursuant to this Rule shall be deemed as members appointed by the Yeongjong-gu Election Commission, Jemulpo-gu Election Commission, and Geomdan-gu Election Commission, respectively, and shall serve for the remainder of their terms.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(처분 등의 승계) ① 이 규칙 시행 전에 인천광역시 중구선거관리위원회ㆍ동구선거관리위원회ㆍ서구선거관리위원회가 영종구선거관리위원회ㆍ제물포구선거관리위원회ㆍ검단구선거관리위원회의 관할구역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위는 각각 영종구선거관리위원회ㆍ제물포구선거관리위원회ㆍ검단구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Succession to Dispositions, etc.) ① Any disposition or other act performed by the Incheon Metropolitan City Jung-gu Election Commission, Dong-gu Election Commission, and Seo-gu Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Yeongjong-gu Election Commission, Jemulpo-gu Election Commission, and Geomdan-gu Election Commission shall be deemed to be a disposition or other act performed by the Yeongjong-gu Election Commission, Jemulpo-gu Election Commission, and Geomdan-gu Election Commission, respectively.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행 전에 인천광역시 중구선거관리위원회ㆍ동구선거관리위원회ㆍ서구선거관리위원회에 한 신고ㆍ신청이나 그 밖의 행위는 각각 해당 지역을 관할구역으로 하는 영종구선거관리위원회ㆍ제물포구선거관리위원회ㆍ검단구선거관리위원회에 한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Any report, application, or other act made to the Incheon Metropolitan City Jung-gu Election Commission, Dong-gu Election Commission, or Seo-gu Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been made to the Yeongjong-gu Election Commission, Jemulpo-gu Election Commission, or Geomdan-gu Election Commission, respectively, which have jurisdiction over the respective areas.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(경과조치) 이 규칙 시행 당시 화성시갑선거관리위원회 및 화성시을선거관리위원회가 각각 위촉하여 재임 중인 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원 가운데 이 규칙에 따라 설치되는 화성시만세구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시효행구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시병점구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시동탄구선거관리위원회 관할구역 안의 읍ㆍ면ㆍ동선거관리위원회위원은 각각 화성시만세구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시효행구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시병점구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시동탄구선거관리위원회가 위촉한 위원으로 보되, 남은 임기 동안 재임한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Transitional Measures) Among the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees who were appointed by the Hwaseong-si Gap Election Management Committee and the Hwaseong-si Eul Election Management Committee and are currently serving at the time of the enforcement of this rule, the members of the Eup, Myeon, and Dong election management committees within the jurisdiction of the Hwaseong-si Manse-gu Election Management Committee, Hwaseong-si Hyohaeng-gu Election Management Committee, Hwaseong-si Byeongjeom-gu Election Management Committee, and Hwaseong-si Dongtan-gu Election Management Committee established pursuant to this rule shall be deemed as members appointed by the Hwaseong-si Manse-gu Election Management Committee, Hwaseong-si Hyohaeng-gu Election Management Committee, Hwaseong-si Byeongjeom-gu Election Management Committee, and Hwaseong-si Dongtan-gu Election Management Committee, respectively, and shall serve for the remainder of their term.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(처분 등의 승계) ① 이 규칙 시행 전에 화성시갑선거관리위원회 및 화성시을선거관리위원회가 화성시만세구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시효행구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시병점구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시동탄구선거관리위원회의 관할구역에 관한 사항에 대하여 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위는 각각 화성시만세구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시효행구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시병점구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시동탄구선거관리위원회가 행한 처분이나 그 밖의 행위로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Succession to Dispositions, etc.) ① Any disposition or other act performed by the Hwaseong-si Gap Election Commission and the Hwaseong-si Eul Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule concerning matters within the jurisdictional areas of the Hwaseong-si Manse-gu Election Commission, Hwaseong-si Hyohaeng-gu Election Commission, Hwaseong-si Byeongjeom-gu Election Commission, and Hwaseong-si Dongtan-gu Election Commission shall be deemed to be a disposition or other act performed by the Hwaseong-si Manse-gu Election Commission, Hwaseong-si Hyohaeng-gu Election Commission, Hwaseong-si Byeongjeom-gu Election Commission, and Hwaseong-si Dongtan-gu Election Commission, respectively.

rows.source_ko: ② 이 규칙 시행 전에 화성시갑선거관리위원회 및 화성시을선거관리위원회에 한 신고ㆍ신청이나 그 밖의 행위는 각각 해당 지역을 관할구역으로 하는 화성시만세구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시효행구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시병점구선거관리위원회ㆍ화성시동탄구선거관리위원회에 한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② Any report, application, or other act made to the Hwaseong-si Gap Election Commission and the Hwaseong-si Eul Election Commission prior to the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed to have been made to the Hwaseong-si Manse-gu Election Commission, Hwaseong-si Hyohaeng-gu Election Commission, Hwaseong-si Byeongjeom-gu Election Commission, and Hwaseong-si Dongtan-gu Election Commission, respectively, which have jurisdiction over the respective areas.
